title: Fouche saw the TR3B twice

tellings.quote: he Fuchche himself stated he had seen uh the craft twice. Once in Edwards Air Force Base and once somewhere else

plain: A man named Edgar Fouche claimed he saw the TR3B, a rumoured secret triangular US aircraft, twice: once at Edwards Air Force Base and once somewhere else. A researcher who posts as UAPGerb tells Michels this, relaying what Fouche said, including in a talk Fouche gave at the International UFO Congress in 1998. If true, it would mean the US flies craft far beyond its known aircraft.
